result.topic_en: Gauss substitutes $a^{n-1}tt=yy$, $a=xx$ into a product/series expression, distinguishes the cases of n odd and even, and writes out the resulting series with Gaussian-binomial-type coefficients $\frac{1-x^{2n}}{1-xx}\cdot\frac{1-x^{2n-2}}{1-x^4}\cdots$.
